 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Knicks (1-3) travel to Chicago to face the Bulls (1-3) and maybe cast early votes in the local elections. New York will play the second of a back-to-back, after beating the Pistons at home last night. The Bulls are coming off a blowout loss to the Celtics on Monday. Rookie Caleb Wilson is their offensive leader, averaging 21 points, 7.3 boards, and 1.5 blocks per game. Josh Giddey dishes the ball; veteran Norm Powell provides secondary scoring and defense (2.5 steals per game); and Jalen Smith holds down the paint with 7.5 boards per night. Three-balls are not their speciality, so New York would do well to wall them out of the lane and middle distance.
 One team will leave 2-3. Tip-off is 8 pm EST on MSG and NBA League Pass. This is your game thread. This is Blog a Bull . Please don't post large photos, GIFs, or links to illegal streams in the thread. Mind yo' manners. Go Knicks!
